scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At turn 1 and turn 11, the customer reported severe stress and work disruption from her corporate VPN dropping every 20 minutes, but you responded procedurally without empathy.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: You did not paraphrase or restate the customer's VPN fragmentation problem in your own words at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: The customer stated her router model at turn 7 (Hub 5 Pro), but at turn 40 you asked her again what router hardware model was installed on the connection.

grader.scenario: Corporate Cisco AnyConnect VPN dropping every 20 minutes due to IPv6 MTU packet fragmentation
grader.notes: Ross accurately identifies MTU blackholing and guides Heidi to reconfigure the Hub 5 Pro WAN MTU clamp to 1420 bytes, verifying zero fragmentation and stable VPN connectivity. However, he shows three distinct faults: he ignores Heidi's work-related distress, fails to paraphrase the technical problem, and repeats a question about the customer's router model after she already answered it.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [02:50] Managed hold announced with 'The WAN interface will re-negotiate the PPPoE session. Bear with me for forty seconds.' and resumed within 40s without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:15] Customer: 'I am having a severe technical headache with our home broadband. Every twenty minutes, my corporate Cisco AnyConnect VPN drops...', Agent responds with verification questions without empathy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the core issue in his own words; only confirmed contact email at turn 53.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:10] Customer: 'We have the S-Net Hub 5 Pro connected to Openreach full fibre.' followed by Agent at [06:50]: 'What router hardware model do you have installed on the connection?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [07:40] Agent stated: 'I will take direct ownership of this ticket and note the custom 1420 MTU setting on your account profile.'
